translated_title: Sheinbaum Denies Censorship With Guidelines on Audience Rights: 'There Has Never Been More Freedom'
original_title: Sheinbaum niega censura con lineamientos sobre derechos de las audiencias: “nunca ha habido más libertad”
author: Anahí Del Ángel
meta_description: Still in public consultation, the guidelines were agreed with broadcasters, Sheinbaum says, recalling how past governments phoned owners to fire critics.
